aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

exr_export.description: Also export an EXR file alongside the MP4. Requires hdr=true and HDR access.
exr_export.title: Exr Export

hdr.description: Generate an HDR-encoded MP4. Requires HDR access on the account and a resolution of 720p or 1080p; not supported with 10s or loop.
hdr.title: Hdr

loop.description: Generate a seamless loop. Only valid for 5s, standard-dynamic-range generations without an end frame.
loop.title: Loop

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate.
examples: A herd of wild horses galloping across a dusty desert plain under a blazing midday sun, their manes flying in the wind; wide tracking shot.
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. Higher resolutions cost more.
resolution.title: Resolution

exr_file.description: The generated EXR sidecar when exr_export is true. This may be a single EXR file or a ZIP package depending on Luma's export shape.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
